reviews.title: Will work with AMD but unstable when overclocked using Automation
reviews.comment: I accidentally got this for AMD build i I wanted the rgb ice look.  It still works but is unstable when trying to overclock using automation. ( may need to manually OC for AMD) . Happy with the looks ans seams to perform ok.
reviews.author: Rome

reviews.title: Unique look
reviews.comment: It’s so pretty! Me and my dad were building my pc for Christmas. I could have gone for cheaper options but I really fell in love with the crystal look. It looks very unique. I have had no issues.
